intervals.coverage: at least nominal under independent matched-block stream replications
intervals.multiplicity: Marginal 95% CIs are not simultaneous. Only simultaneous_primary_ci95 covers the pooled primary family.

estimand.pooled: Equal-weight average of the fixed batch-seed by agent-orientation strata in each identity direction.
estimand.per_seed: Equal-weight average of the two fixed agent-seed orientations within the named batch seed.
estimand.replication_unit: Matched game block across budgets; identity directions are never paired.
estimand.assumptions: Independent pseudorandom streams across distinct game blocks; arbitrary within-block budget dependence and stratum heterogeneity.
estimand.boundaries: Conditional on the two fixed agent seeds and tested batch-seed/orientation design; no population-of-agent-seeds, learning, convergence, or off-path-policy claim.
